name: Starbucks
look: Warm cream canvas with a four-tier green system, full-pill buttons, gold reserved for rewards ceremony only.

hero.title: Free coffee is just the beginning
hero.sub: Earn a star on every purchase. Redeem for drinks, food and merchandise — and get your birthday drink on us, no minimum spend.

features.title: Three steps, then free coffee
features.sub: Join, order and earn. No card to carry and no points that quietly expire on you.

items.title: Join for free
items.body: Create an account in the app or in store. There is no fee, no minimum spend and no card to keep in your wallet.

items.title: Earn stars
items.body: Two stars for every pound, doubled on Wednesdays and on any drink you bring your own cup for.

items.title: Redeem how you like
items.body: Fifty stars for a handcrafted drink, a hundred and fifty for food, four hundred for merchandise.

items.title: Order ahead
items.body: Order from the app and collect from the counter without queueing. Most orders are ready in four minutes.

items.title: Birthday drink
items.body: Any handcrafted drink, any size, free on your birthday. No minimum spend and no stars required.

items.title: Bring your own cup
items.body: Twenty-five pence off and double stars, every time, on every drink in every store.

showcases.title: Stars that do not quietly expire
showcases.body: Stars stay on the account for twelve months from the day they are earned, and the app tells you which ones are closest to expiring rather than letting them lapse and hoping you do not notice.

showcases.title: Paid above the market, verified
showcases.body: Every bean is bought at or above the market rate through a verified programme, and the farm-level payment data is published annually rather than summarised in a brochure.

gallery.title: The menu
gallery.sub: Seasonal drinks, everyday favourites and the food that goes with them.

testimonial.quote: I brought my own cup for a month to see whether the discount was real. It was twenty-five pence and double stars every single time, including the two mornings I forgot to mention it.
testimonial.name: Grace Whitfield

pricing.title: Gift cards
pricing.sub: Physical or digital, delivered instantly, and they never expire.

tiers.name: Business
tiers.desc: Bulk orders for teams and clients.

items.a: Stars stay on the account for twelve months from the day they are earned. The app shows the expiry date for each batch and reminds you before any batch lapses.

items.q: Can I earn stars on gift card purchases?
items.a: You earn stars when you pay with a registered gift card, not when you buy one. That avoids earning twice on the same money.

items.q: Does bring-your-own-cup work with order ahead?
items.a: Yes. Select it in the app when ordering and hand the cup over at collection. The discount and the double stars apply the same way.

items.q: What happens to my stars if I do not visit for a while?
items.a: Nothing for twelve months. Individual star batches expire on their own dates rather than the whole balance being wiped after a period of inactivity.

cta.title: Join Alder Rewards
cta.sub: Free to join, two stars per pound, and a free drink on your birthday.

notes: There is no single 'brand green'. Four greens map to four surface roles — Starbucks for headings, Accent for filled CTAs, House for dark bands and footer, Uplift for decorative moments.
Gold is Rewards-status ceremony only. Using it as a general accent is the fastest way to break this system.
The canvas is warm cream, never cold white — it references café materials, and every neutral is tinted to match.
Buttons are full pills at 50px radius, universally. The signature micro-interaction is scale(0.95) on active press.
Cards sit at 12px with whisper-soft shadows: flat, plus a hint of lift, never a floating panel.
